transitions.pre_cond: agent_card.field.has_default_value = true & agent_card.field.marked_required = false & agent_card.field.marked_optional = false

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Agent Card: A JSON metadata document published by an A2A Server, describing its identity, capabilities, skills, service endpoint, and authentication requirements.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the agent declares support but has not configured an extended card, it MUST return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError.
actions: Return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients SHOULD validate capability support by examining the Agent Card before attempting operations that require optional capabilities.
actions: Examine the Agent Card to validate that required optional capabilities are declared before attempting the operation

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients MAY choose any protocol declared by the agent
actions: Select any protocol from the set of protocols declared in the agent's AgentCard

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients SHOULD implement fallback logic for alternative protocols
actions: Implement fallback logic that attempts alternative protocols when the primary protocol is unavailable or fails

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: When a breaking change is introduced to a binding, a new URI MUST be used so that clients can distinguish between incompatible versions:
actions: Assign a new URI to the updated binding
Ensure the new URI is distinct from all prior incompatible versions of the binding

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Step 1: Client fetches the public Agent Card via GET /.well-known/agent-card.json; server responds with an Agent Card whose capabilities.extendedAgentCard=true and securitySchemes define the required authentication scheme.
actions: Client sends GET /.well-known/agent-card.json HTTP/1.1 to Host: example.com
Server returns Agent Card containing capabilities.extendedAgentCard=true and securitySchemes with OpenID Connect scheme entry

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Discovery of Requirements: The client discovers the server's required authentication schemes via the securitySchemes field in the AgentCard.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client discovers the server's required authentication schemes via the securitySchemes field in the AgentCard, then proceeds to obtain credentials.
actions: Client reads securitySchemes field from AgentCard
Client identifies required authentication scheme

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: A2A Servers MUST make an Agent Card available. The Agent Card describes the server's identity, capabilities, skills, and interaction requirements.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients MUST follow these rules:
actions: Parse supportedInterfaces if present and select the first supported transport
Prefer earlier entries in the ordered list when multiple options are supported
Use the correct URL for the selected transport

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients MUST parse supportedInterfaces if present, and select the first supported transport; prefer earlier entries in the ordered list when multiple options are supported
actions: Parse supportedInterfaces field from AgentCard
Iterate entries in declared preference order
Select first entry whose transport is supported by the client

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients MUST use the correct URL for the selected transport
actions: Read url field from the selected interface entry
Use that url as the endpoint for the chosen transport

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Before signing, the Agent Card content MUST be canonicalized using the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) as defined in RFC 8785.
actions: Canonicalize Agent Card content using JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) as defined in RFC 8785 before signing

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Before canonicalization, the JSON representation MUST respect Protocol Buffer field presence semantics as defined in Section 5.7.
actions: Apply Protocol Buffer field presence semantics to JSON representation before canonicalization

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Fields marked with the optional keyword that were not explicitly set MUST be omitted from the JSON object
actions: Omit optional fields that were not explicitly set from the JSON object

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Fields marked with optional that were explicitly set to a value (even if that value matches a default) MUST be included in the JSON object
actions: Include optional fields that were explicitly set in the JSON object even if the value matches a default

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Fields marked with REQUIRED MUST always be present, even if the field value matches the default.
actions: Include REQUIRED fields in the JSON object even if the field value matches the default

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Fields with default values MUST be omitted unless the field is marked as REQUIRED or has the optional keyword.
statements.pre_cond: agent_card.field.has_default_value = true & agent_card.field.marked_required = false & agent_card.field.marked_optional = false
actions: Omit fields with default values from the JSON object unless the field is marked as REQUIRED or has the optional keyword

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: The Agent Card JSON MUST be canonicalized according to RFC 8785, which specifies:
actions: Apply predictable lexicographic ordering of object properties
Apply consistent representation of numbers, strings, and other primitive values
Remove insignificant whitespace

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: The signatures field itself MUST be excluded from the content being signed to avoid circular dependencies.
actions: Exclude the signatures field from the content being signed

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: The protected header MUST include:
actions: Include alg parameter in JWS protected header
Include kid parameter in JWS protected header

statements.subject: server
statements.description: typ: SHOULD be set to "JOSE" for JWS
actions: Set typ parameter to 'JOSE' in JWS protected header

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: The protected header MAY include:
actions: Optionally include jku (URL to JSON Web Key Set containing the public key) parameter in JWS protected header

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients verifying Agent Card signatures MUST:
actions: Extract the signature from the signatures array
Retrieve the public key using the kid and jku or from a trusted key store
Remove properties with default values from the received Agent Card
Exclude the signatures field
Canonicalize the resulting JSON using RFC 8785
Verify the signature against the canonicalized payload

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients SHOULD verify at least one signature before trusting an Agent Card
actions: Verify at least one signature in the Agent Card before trusting it

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Public keys SHOULD be retrieved over secure channels (HTTPS)
actions: Retrieve public keys over secure channels (HTTPS)

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Expired or revoked keys MUST NOT be used for verification
actions: Reject use of expired or revoked keys for signature verification

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agent Card HTTP endpoints SHOULD include a Cache-Control response header with a max-age directive appropriate for the agent's expected update frequency
actions: Include Cache-Control response header with a max-age directive appropriate for the agent's expected update frequency in Agent Card HTTP responses

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agent Card HTTP endpoints SHOULD include an ETag response header derived from the Agent Card's version field or a hash of the card content
actions: Include an ETag response header derived from the Agent Card's version field or a hash of the card content in Agent Card HTTP responses

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agent Card HTTP endpoints MAY include a Last-Modified response header
actions: Optionally include a Last-Modified response header in Agent Card HTTP responses

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients SHOULD honor HTTP caching semantics as defined in RFC 9111 when fetching Agent Cards
actions: Honor HTTP caching semantics as defined in RFC 9111 when fetching Agent Cards

statements.subject: client
statements.description: When a cached Agent Card has expired, clients SHOULD use conditional requests (If-None-Match with the stored ETag, or If-Modified-Since) to avoid re-downloading unchanged cards
actions: Send conditional request using If-None-Match with the stored ETag, or If-Modified-Since header to avoid re-downloading unchanged Agent Cards

statements.subject: client
statements.description: When the server does not include caching headers, clients MAY apply an implementation-specific default cache duration
actions: Apply an implementation-specific default cache duration when the server does not include caching headers

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: When a cached Agent Card has expired, clients SHOULD use conditional requests (If-None-Match with the stored ETag, or If-Modified-Since) to avoid re-downloading unchanged cards

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Custom bindings MUST be declared in the Agent Card:
actions: Declare the custom binding in the Agent Card under supportedInterfaces
Include a Transport Identifier URI identifying the binding
Include the full Endpoint URL where the binding is available

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: When capabilities.extendedAgentCard is false or not present, the operation MUST return UnsupportedOperationError

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: When support is declared but no extended card is configured, the operation MUST return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents SHOULD implement appropriate caching headers to control client-side caching of extended cards
actions: Include appropriate caching headers in the extended agent card response to control client-side caching

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients retrieving extended cards SHOULD replace their cached public Agent Card with the extended version for the duration of their authenticated session
actions: Replace the cached public Agent Card with the extended card for the duration of the authenticated session

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When capabilities.extendedAgentCard is false or not present, the operation MUST return UnsupportedOperationError
actions: Return UnsupportedOperationError when capabilities.extendedAgentCard is false or not present

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When support is declared but no extended card is configured, the operation MUST return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError
actions: Return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError when extended card support is declared but no extended card is configured

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The resource at this URI MUST return an AgentCard object as defined in Section 4.4.1 of the A2A specification.
actions: Return an AgentCard object as defined in Section 4.4.1 at the /.well-known/agent-card.json URI

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients SHOULD verify signatures when present to ensure the Agent Card has not been tampered with
actions: Verify the JWS signature on the Agent Card when a signature is present
Confirm the Agent Card has not been tampered with

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: All legacy names and anchors MUST remain resolvable until the stated earliest removal version.
actions: Keep all legacy protocol message names and anchors resolvable
Maintain resolvability until the stated earliest removal version is reached

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Custom bindings MUST comply with all requirements defined in Section 5 (Protocol Binding Requirements and Interoperability).
actions: Comply with all requirements defined in Section 5 (Protocol Binding Requirements and Interoperability)
